```plato

    // Which way the boundary winds. A degenerate ring reports CounterClockwise: there
    // is no better answer, and the repair below treats it as already correct.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Winding.
    Winding(p: Polygon2D): WindingOrder
        => p.Points.ShoelaceArea < 0.0 ? WindingOrder.Clockwise : WindingOrder.CounterClockwise;
```
